scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dacci/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @dacci/content-engine && npm run build --workspace @dacci/github-sync && npm run build --workspace @dacci/api && npm run build --workspace @dacci/web && npm run build --workspace @dacci/cli
scripts.build:cli: npm run build --workspace @dacci/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @dacci/content-engine && npm run build --workspace @dacci/github-sync && npm run build --workspace @dacci/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @dacci/content-engine && npm run test --workspace @dacci/github-sync && npm run test --workspace @dacci/api && npm run test --workspace @dacci/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @dacci/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace @dacci/content-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @dacci/github-sync && npm run typecheck --workspace @dacci/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @dacci/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @dacci/cli
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
